[{"sha":"5b4d814e6a041840d0973cf2e2426aac678ec1f7","html_url":"https://github.com/arigsela/kubernetes/commit/5b4d814e6a041840d0973cf2e2426aac678ec1f7","commit":{"message":"feat(okf): move the knowledge docs to OKF v0.2

OKF moved to GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format and is now v0.2,
which reserves `status` and `sources` and adds trust and lifecycle fields.

- Export (`gen-okf.py --export`) is now strictly v0.2-conformant: index
  files become §8 listings (their prose moves to overview.md), and each
  concept gets `generated` from git, `verified` and `stale_after` from
  `last_reviewed`, and `sources` as {id, resource, last_modified}. The
  v0.1 `timestamp` is gone.
- `verified.by` is human only when the commit that bumped `last_reviewed`
  has a Reviewed-by trailer or no Claude co-author; otherwise the agent.
- `status` values renamed current/wip -> stable/draft in all docs,
  templates and the TechDocs mirror.
- Validator accepts mapping-form sources and checks per-claim footnotes
  ([^id]) against sources ids.
- homelab-knowledge prompt explains the mapping form and footnotes.
- Spec links point at the new repo; okf_version bumped to 0.2.
